remarks: A rare chance to get into a prime Norwalk location at the right price. This is the kind of opportunity that doesn't come around often-an entry point into a highly desirable Norwalk neighborhood at a price that allows you to create value over time. Whether you're a buyer looking to personalize your home or an investor seeking long-term upside, this property offers a compelling combination of location, potential, and equity-building opportunity. The home's interior was just professionally painted & features vinyl siding, vinyl replacement windows, and an expansive wrap-around deck with multiple entry points-offering great outdoor living potential. Though updates are needed inside and out, the home offers strong bones and a layout that's ready to be re-imagined to suit your style and needs. With the right vision and improvements, you can maximize the home's value and make the most of its strong footprint. The location truly sets this property apart-just minutes to both the East Norwalk and SoNo train stations for easy commuting, and close to Stew Leonard's, The SoNo Collection, and a wide variety of shops, restaurants, and cafes in the vibrant SoNo and Wall Street districts. You're also just a short drive to Calf Pasture Beach, Taylor Farm, Cranbury Park. Whether you're looking for your next project or simply want to break into a great area at an attainable price, this is your chance to capitalize on a unique opportunity. Property to be sold 'as-is'.
